text:
Priya (PM): Hey team — uploaded the FY26 Q2 company-level goals draft. Need a final pass by EOD tomorrow. Key areas: Hosted latency SLO, Dedicated capacity expansion, Private pilot for regulated customers, and go-to-market readiness. Link: https://redwoodinference.atlassian.net/wiki/COMPANY-OKR-FY26-Q2
okrs-bot: Reminder: FY26 Q2 OKR draft review deadline in 24h. Please react with :thumbsup: when you sign off.
Matt (VP Product): skimmed. Two quick asks: 1) make latency target concrete (P50/P95), 2) make launch criteria for Private pilot measurable.
Ana (Eng): Heads up — infra staffing + quant support are blockers for Private pilot timeline as written. Need 3 eng FTEs + 2 infra GPUs reserved to hit end-of-quarter launch.
Sasha (Strategy): If we limit Dedicated expansion to a single EU region this quarter, we can free up capacity for Private pilot customers. less scope, faster impact.
Jordan (CEO): I don't want to delay Private offering entirely. Suggest compromise: keep pilot but limit to 2 customers, explicit LOI/PII review clause, and measurable uptake goals. Also want a crisp customer success KPI.
Priya (PM): Proposal: Private pilot = 2 customers, LOI signed, SOC2-like checklist completed, and a performance gate: P95 latency < 200ms on customer workload. Drafted new checklist below:
```
- LOI signed by customer legal
- Security review (KMS, network isolation) completed
- Performance gate: P95 < 200ms on representative traces
- Runbook + SLO docs published
- Success criteria: 2 customers onboarded + 1 production feature using private route
```
Matt (VP Product): Add a customer integration metric: average time-to-integration < 4 weeks for pilot customers. Also recommend a stretch target on cost per token for Dedicated.
Ana (Eng): We can meet those if hiring + infra budget approved by next sprint. I'll update the RFC with back-of-envelope resource planner and a 6-week rollout plan.
Sasha (Strategy): Agree with 2-customer pilot. Also recommend making Dedicated expansion an opt-in sales motion (enterprise only) to reduce immediate scope.
Priya (PM): Updated doc linked. If we get approvals here, I'll lock the company goals and move to OKR tracker. Can each of you reply with :thumbsup: or :eyes: + brief note if you want to reopen scope?
Matt (VP Product): :thumbsup: pending numbers update (I'll add them today).
Jordan (CEO): :thumbsup: subject to LOI clause being explicit.
Ana (Eng): :eyes: I'll add the resource estimate + timeline by EOD.
Sasha (Strategy): :thumbsup: on limited rollout + stronger go-to-market language.
Priya (PM): Thanks — locking draft Friday noon unless anyone objects. Tagging @all for final sign-off.
Priya (PM): Locking company-level goals at 1845682600 — final doc pushed to tracker. Thanks team. :rocket:
